$$
\text{Total pages} = (\text{pages per chapter} \times \text{chapters per book}) \times \text{number of books}

$$

$$
60 \times 3 = 180 \text{ pages per book}
$$

Then, since there are **3 books**, multiply by 3:

$$
180 \times 3 = 540 \text{ pages}
$$

---

\boxed{540}

$$

$$
